question: Which tab in MS Word 365 contains options to change page margins, orientation and size?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Layout**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Layout** tab in **MS Word 365** is designed to handle various aspects of the page formatting.
 
• It contains options to adjust the **page margins**, which define the space between the text and the edge of the page.
